title: vectorize-io/hindsight: long-term memory that learns from agent experience
friendlyTitle: Hindsight gives AI agents long-term memory
summary: Hindsight is an open-source memory system for agents that stores experience, recalls relevant information and updates higher-level knowledge over time. The active project supports multiple agent and coding-tool integrations.
friendlySummary: Hindsight helps an AI agent remember useful facts and lessons across different sessions. It can connect with several agent tools.
whyItMatters: Developers can add durable memory to assistants that must carry preferences, decisions and lessons across sessions. Test retrieval quality and deletion boundaries carefully before storing sensitive material.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when an assistant needs to remember choices or past work. Check privacy, deletion and recall quality before adding sensitive information.
